title: docc.json
description: Configuration of docc. Every field is optional; unknown keys are errors.

src.description: Source documents, relative to the project root.

roots.description: Ids of the root documents; reachability is counted from them. Ignored when tree is folders.

tree.description: What the document tree is: parents nests documents by their parent field below the roots; folders is the folder structure of src (a folder's own page is the document named like the folder inside it, e.g. decisions/decisions.json; siblings by order, then title), and roots, DOC203 and DOC205 do not apply.

tags.description: Registry of allowed tags; absent: no registry.

recommended.description: false turns the recommended preset off; core rules stay on.

numbering.description: true numbers pages below the roots (1, 1.2) and the sections of their $sections fields (1.2.1) in headings, navigation and link text.

lang.description: Language of the fixed labels in the generated Markdown and HTML (Parent, Referenced by, On this page...).

maxWarnings.description: Exit code 1 when there are more warnings than this.

changesSince.description: Git revision (tag, branch or commit) of the version the reader last received: the HTML file shows the changes since it by default and keeps no history before it.

rules.description: Rule name (its code works too, with a DOC902 warning) or group name to a level or an object with parameters.

given.description: JSON pointer to a string field; * matches any array element or object key.

forbid.description: Go (RE2) regular expression; a match is a violation.

require.description: Go (RE2) regular expression that must match.

branding.description: Company branding of the HTML build (docc build --html); absent: no branding. The Markdown output is not branded.

name.description: Company name in the header, the footer and the printed first page.

url.description: Company site; the logo and the name in the footer link to it.

logo.description: Logo file from the project root (png, jpg, jpeg, gif, svg, webp), embedded in the HTML. It sits on the dark header, so a light logo is expected.

accent.description: Accent colour for the dark theme and the header; links in the page body use it too when accentLight is absent.

accentLight.description: Accent colour on the light theme; must read on white (contrast 4.5 and more).

header.description: Background of the header with the logo.

scan.description: Masks from the project root for docc: tags in code; absent: DOC401 and DOC403 do not run.
